race.description: Dale & Hitchcock Heart Of Queanbeyan Country Boosted Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: STAR OF LILY (4) went back-to-back before tackling Highway company last start where she was just fair. Back to this level is a good move and Keatings hopping on board is a positive sign. Can get to the front and will take catching. SOOO CRAZY (1) resumes after eight months off and brings solid Open and Class 3 form from last campaign, with a 2kg claim helping offset 62kg. Has good early speed and will be in this for a long way if fit enough fresh. ROYAL MEMORY (7) arrives off a track-and-distance BM58 win and gets weight relief as she does rise in grade. Things look to work out nicely for her again from an inside draw though and she can play a leading role. WRITTEN BY LUCY (2) resumes after six months, has two wins at the distance, handles wet ground well and reunites with Damon Budler, whose record on her is a major positive. VELLA MAGIC (5) is better than she showed last start and won't be far away.
